note: A per-column parallel window reconciles an operational definition its overlapping nested editions disagree on as the single-column path does (#1625): the entry binds, the 2021-2022 First states carry no operational definition, and 2020, covered only by CVID 100, keeps its own. The refusal twin on another field is representation-parallel-columns-stale-when-nested-editions-disagree-on-the-reference-period.
fails_if: `compile_parallel_representations` again treats an `operational_definition` conflict between overlapping nested editions of a `column_metadata = "per_column"` entry as stale, or a state formed over the disagreeing editions picks one of their operational definitions

sources.description: Variable 1: First is pooled 2020-2022 (CVID 100) and again nested 2021-2022 (CVID 103); Second is 2022-2024 (CVID 101). The two First editions state contrary operational definitions.
